sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount AS avg_fare, CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' END AS d_day_name FROM whybot.yellow_daily y WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-27') ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
